ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (lateral regions) to low-intensity black pixels (medial and trailing edges).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white fields occupying the distal halves of both lobes; transitions to high-frequency black mottling and solid black pigmentation towards the central peduncle area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an estimated 40-degree interior angle and significant bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations along both trailing edges; distinct macro-level semi-circular excision located on the right lobe trailing edge approximately 40% from the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the upper trailing edges of both lobes, resulting in a distinct 'winged' profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacle scars) at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear rake marks visible against the white field of the left lobe, predominantly in vertical and diagonal orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular u-shaped notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe and a jagged indentation on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent dark horizontal oval marking located in the lower-central region of the left lobe's white field.
